_om: Engelsk översättning av monster.json. Bara texter; siffrorna och tecknen står i den svenska filen. Varelserna kopplas ihop med sina id:n. Valen i val är substantivfraser, eftersom samma ord sätts in efter både du och en varelse eller vandrare (duell här, pvp_duell och pvp_vantar i texter.json).

dyker_upp: Something pale and many-legged crawls out of a crack. It has no eyes, but it turns towards you.
A pale crawler peels itself from the wall, where it lay so close you took it for part of the stone.
dor: The Pale Crawler curls up and goes still. Beneath it lie a few coins.

dyker_upp: A serpent spawn, long as a man, rises from a heap of dust. It hisses and strikes at once.
A young, glistening serpent spawn lies coiled in the corner. It has already seen you.
dor: The Serpent Spawn writhes one last time and then lies still. Gold glints in its belly.

dyker_upp: A figure in armour of overlapping scales steps forward. It holds a shield before it and waits.
The Scale Warden stands motionless in the middle of the room. Its armour looks grown rather than forged.
dor: The Scale Warden collapses. The armour is empty, like a shed skin. Coins rattle out of it.

dyker_upp: A greenish shape glides forward. It wears an adventurer's clothes, but they hang in rags and are bleached, as if they had lain in acid.
A ghast rises out of the floor. It looks at your bag, as if it remembers what it was like to carry one.
dor: The Bile Ghast dissolves into a bitter mist. Left behind is the gold it never got out with.

dyker_upp: A being built of curved white bones rises up. The bones are all alike, like ribs from one and the same beast.
dor: The Bone Keeper falls apart into a heap of ribs. Between them lies gold.

tjanare: You are dead, but the tower does not let you go. You feel its creatures as if they were your own fingers. Tab picks a creature, the arrows move it one room per round, space lets it rest. On a touch screen they are called Switch, the arrows and ·.
tjanare_andra: {namn} is dead, but something of {namn} remains in the tower. The creatures now move with purpose.
inget_monster_har: There is nothing here to fight.
